request.description: A cramped low-ceilinged stone cellar, rough damp floor, stacks of wooden crates crowding both sides, a wooden ladder leading to an open ceiling hatch, low beams and a single hanging oil lamp. A narrow route runs between crates. No reception desk, pews, shop shelves, vehicles or people.
